items.source: Configure the ResourceUrlProvider that can be used by ResourceTransformer instances.
items.translation: 配置 ResourceUrlProvider，供 ResourceTransformer 实例使用。

items.source: Then use additional methods on the returned ResourceHandlerRegistration to add one or more locations from which to serve static content from (for example, {"/", "classpath:/META-INF/public-web-resources/"}) or to specify a cache period for served resources.
items.translation: 然后使用返回的ResourceHandlerRegistration上的附加方法，添加一个或多个用于提供静态内容的源位置（例如，{"/"，"classpath:/META-INF/public-web-resources/"}），或指定已提供资源的缓存期限。

items.source: Patterns like "/static/**" or "/css/{filename:\\w+\\.css}" are allowed. See PathPattern for more details on the syntax.
items.translation: 允许使用类似 `"/static/**"` 或 `"/css/{filename:\\w+\\.css}"` 的模式。有关语法的更多详细信息，请参阅 PathPattern。

items.source: To create a resource handler, use addResourceHandler(String...) providing the URL path patterns for which the handler should be invoked to serve static resources (for example, "/resources/**").
items.translation: 要创建资源处理器，请使用addResourceHandler(String...)提供应调用该处理器以提供静态资源的 URL 路径模式（例如，"/resources/**"）。

items.source: Return a handler mapping with the mapped resource handlers; or null in case of no registrations.
items.translation: 返回包含已映射资源处理器的处理器映射；若无注册，则返回 `null`。

items.source:
Create a new resource handler registry for the given resource loader
(typically an application context).
items.translation: 为给定的资源加载器（通常是应用程序上下文）创建一个新的资源处理器注册表。

items.source: Whether a resource handler has already been registered for the given path pattern.
items.translation: 给定路径模式是否已注册了资源处理器。

items.source: a ResourceHandlerRegistration to use to further configure the registered resource handler
items.translation: 一个ResourceHandlerRegistration，用于进一步配置已注册的资源处理器。

items.source: resourceUrlProvider - the resource URL provider to use
items.translation: resourceUrlProvider - 要使用的资源 URL 提供程序

items.source: Specify the order to use for resource handling relative to other HandlerMappings configured in the Spring configuration.
items.translation: 指定相对于 Spring 配置中配置的其他 HandlerMapping 的资源处理顺序。

items.source:
Add a resource handler for serving static resources based on the specified
URL path patterns.
items.translation: 添加资源处理器，用于根据指定的 URL 路径模式提供静态资源。
